submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires on tokens that advance the claim-structure of abstract or technical exposition once the left context establishes that register: the clause's predicating word — an authorial or collective subject pronoun ('we'), a finite auxiliary ('has'/'have'/'had'/'being'), a reporting verb ('require'/'offers'), or a connective/passive marker ('by'/'without') — and structural organizers (paragraph breaks, citation brackets) inside technical documents. The same function words with concrete, everyday subjects and scene-setting ('kids', 'song', 'beach') stay near zero, so firing is gated by long-range abstract/collective context, not by the peak token alone.

Factors Influencing Online Brand Trust: Evidence from Online Buyers in Kathmandu Valley

This paper aims to identify the factors that influence consumers’ online purchasing behavior in the Kathmandu Valley and understand the relationship between trust and the independent factors of trust in their buying behavior. The analysis is descriptive in nature and focuses on hypothesis testing using structured questionnaire and interview to collect primary data from a sample size of 200 respondents focusing on jobholders, business people, students and housewives. The secondary data is taken based on reports, published articles, websites and journals. Results of the study indicate that a majority of the respondents believe trust is an important factor for online purchase. Though some of the respondents feel that time-saving is one of the important factors for purchasing online, 56 percent of the respondents prefer to shop online only three times a year. The study also shows that the maximum number of respondents prefer buying tickets more than any other commodity online. Even though priority has been given to brand reputation, respondents did not find information as an important factor influencing an online purchasing decision.

Sadiq al-Mahdi is a Sudanese political leader and intellectual, and a descendant of the nineteenth-century Islamic revolutionary known as "the Mahdi," Muhammad Ahmad. Sadiq received a traditional Muslim education as well as a modern one, graduating from Oxford University in 1957. When his father, Siddiq al-Mahdi, died in 1961, Sadiq became the head of the Mahdist-supported Umma Party. He was prime minister of Sudan from 1966 to 1967, and following the military coup by Ja˓far Numayri in 1969, Sadiq went into exile. He returned to Sudan during a national reconciliation in 1977, but was jailed for his opposition to Numayri's 1983 decrees imposing a form of Islamic law on the country. Following the overthrow of Numayri, Sadiq al-Mahdi was again prime minister (1986–1989), and his government was overthrown by Islamist military officers in 1989. He was a leader in the movements of opposition to the Islamist regime but, at the beginning of the twenty-first century, Sadiq al-Mahdi engaged in efforts to reconcile government and opposition. He has written numerous books advocating effective ijtihad (independent reasoning) in understanding Islam's message in the contemporary world. He is an advocate of democracy in an Islamic context and has provided a contemporary understanding of what messianic leadership (the mission of the Mahdi) means in the modern world.
Sidahmed, Abdel Salam. Politics and Islam in ContemporarySudan. New York: St. Martin's Press, 1996.

Android和苹果iOS系统的移动设备，以及诸多基于微控制器的小型物联网设备，比如智能电灯开关、智能家电、视频流媒体设备、智能电视以及视频游戏机等。
微软瞄准所有设备 不再仅限于PC
微软现在承认，其软件产品和服务的目标平台实际上就是一切，而不仅仅是个人电脑。
微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉(Satya Nadella)曾说过:“数字技术无处不在，正被嵌入每个地方。每件产品、每个人以及每段生活都被数字技术从根本上加以改变。这种情况发生在我们家中、工作场所以及娱乐场所……把整个世界想象成一台计算机真是太棒了，我认为这是我们前进的正确方向。”
这一切都不会让人感到震惊，因为微软始终在进行结构重组，以减少对Windows团队的依赖，并将更多注意力放在诸如云计算和人工智能(AI)这样的高增长领域。
不过，这并不是说Windows对微软来说不再重要。它仍然是非常重要的业务，只是不再仅限于桌面设备，同时也针对企业中基于服务器的计算。
Windows 10是微软计划中的一个重要组成部分，它更像是一个物联网参与者，问题是很少有人看到微软把这些东西拼合起来。
即使微软应用程序现代化的努力远离API(如Win32)，转而更注重网络服务和标准，但由于许多遗留桌面应用程序不会短期内消失，Windows在许多大公司中仍然非常重要。
作为企业数据中心、公共和私有云计算IaaS平台的服务器操作系统，Windows的重要性依然不容置疑。这意味着，我们可能仍然会依赖它至少十年时间，甚至更长时间，即使我们采用以应用程序为中心的技术(如容器、微服务以及SaaS)。
企业和公共部门的行动要慢得多，而且必须考虑到许多依赖关系，但个人技术和家庭则是另一回事。
PC正变得无人问津
在家里，包括苹果Mac在内的个人电脑的使用都在走向终结，许多全新的计算用户甚至不再拥有个人电脑。
随着个人电脑销售下降，有效增长陷入停滞以及智能手机的普及，它们的整体使用似乎表明人们不仅在智能手机上做更多工作，甚至可能完全将手机作为主要计算平台。

readings.explanation: This pole fires on tokens that advance the claim-structure of abstract or technical exposition once the left context establishes that register: the clause's predicating word — an authorial or collective subject pronoun ('we'), a finite auxiliary ('has'/'have'/'had'/'being'), a reporting verb ('require'/'offers'), or a connective/passive marker ('by'/'without') — and structural organizers (paragraph breaks, citation brackets) inside technical documents. The same function words with concrete, everyday subjects and scene-setting ('kids', 'song', 'beach') stay near zero, so firing is gated by long-range abstract/collective context, not by the peak token alone.
Fires on any clause-medial function word (pronouns, auxiliaries, prepositions) regardless of register, predicting equal firing for 'have' in 'The kids have eaten' and in 'Studies have shown'.
Detects only specific local bigrams such as 'Studies have', 'techniques require' or ', we', predicting that swapping a distant fronted adjunct ('Moreover' -> 'So') leaves firing on 'we' unchanged.
